texto: Eleven laps gone here on the coast, and this is still one race.
Caldrix in front, and he has not put a wheel wrong all afternoon.
Marvok has been in that mirror for three laps now, looking for a way through.
The cameras on all six cars are open.
Six of them, and you choose which one you watch.
Noctev third, and he has been quicker than the leader for two laps now.
Runtak and Pentav side by side into the braking zone, and neither of them lifts.
And here comes Quentra, round the outside of Pentav.
And back to the leader. Caldrix, still with a second in hand.
Marvok and Noctev now, wheel to wheel through this long corner.
And Noctev is close enough to try something.
Down to the sea section, Pentav and Quentra still together.
That is three separate fights, and all of them are alive.
Look at Runtak, running right along that kerb.
And the car keeps taking it.
Marvok is right on the back of Caldrix again.
And they are on their feet as this field goes by.
